title: Every message sent incurs costs
body_md: Every text message sent by Pro-finder incurs costs, the amount of which depends on the mobile network operator. If the system is controlled by text message or call, Pro-finder sends a status message back each time.
prev_context: The note on the country code ends on the previous page.
next_context: Section 2.7 with the types of destination numbers follows.
